request.subject: UNIT:CULT:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a small brass bathysphere submarine lying level, no longer than the boat's hull is now: remove the mast, the striped sail, the pennant and the curled prow; the hull becomes one closed short fat barrel of polished brass #c9a24a with shade #8a6a2a and rows of rivets, one big round porthole glowing bright green in its side, a short brass periscope on top and an indigo-blue tail fin #4a43b5 at the stern. Nothing red. Keep the thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
